exposure: Induction of fetal asystole before abortion
outcome: Prevention of unanticipated expulsion of a fetus with cardiorespiratory activity (live birth)
cohort: Pregnant individuals undergoing abortion procedures, particularly at periviable gestations and after fetal viability.
finding: Inducing fetal asystole before abortion is recommended at periviable gestations and after fetal viability to prevent unanticipated live birth, with specific guidance provided on acceptable pharmacologic agents and administration techniques.
gest_age: Periviable gestations and after fetal viability
